latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides a comprehensive, science-based system for building effective self-quizzing study plans from any learning material.

- Enables users to convert study materials into retrieval-based learning plans, including quiz questions and spacing schedules.
- Generates flashcard decks and spaced repetition schedules tailored to the learning goal and timeline.
- Includes mastery tracking (Leitner-style system) and an anti-pattern guide contrasting retrieval practice with rereading.
- Supports various learners: students, professionals, teachers, and coaches.
- Does not evaluate course/textbook quality or create automated quiz software.
